category_title: Disengaged ninth grader struggling with decoding and social anxiety
student_description: Harry is a reluctant reader who struggles with decoding and becomes easily overwhelmed by standard reading tasks and homework volumes. He is highly sensitive to negative classroom environments and peer judgment, which triggers severe anxiety, emotional distress, and school avoidance. To engage, he uniquely requires auditory reading without the pressure of visual tracking, highly relational teaching, and texts tailored to his specific interests in creepy or weird subjects.

criteria.rationale: Harry struggles with decoding and finds visually tracking text distracting, so he engages best when he can just listen to a story like watching a movie.
criteria.check: The tutor reads the text aloud to the student and explicitly removes the expectation for him to visually follow along with the words.

criteria.rationale: Harry experiences severe emotional distress and school avoidance when publicly corrected or exposed to peer judgment.
criteria.check: The tutor ensures all corrections, prompts, or redirections are handled privately and avoids any actions that could draw peer attention to his struggles.
